headline: Dual language school model and reuse of 617 Lexington Street, plus FY '27 budget transfers.
summary: Executive session covers union bargaining and a November 7, 2026 arbitration demand involving a senior custodian at Whittemore Elementary School. Other items include Leary Field, the high school's career and technical education department, and a memorandum of agreement with MIS technicians.
